scene.description: A small population of cut-paper browser-window cards sits in two loose groups on a pale plinth. One group is entirely unlit mid-grey. The other group holds one cream card that glows warmly and carries a single navy paper checkmark badge fixed to its corner.
scene.one_idea: verified figures standing out against unverifiable gaps

objects.state: glowing from within, positioned right of centre, standing slightly apart from the unlit group
fixed to the top corner of the verified card

lighting.key: soft warm key light, upper left, 3000K to 3500K, roughly 40 degrees, large diffuser, soft gradual shadow edges
lighting.fill: weak cool fill from the right, about one quarter key strength
lighting.practical: single internal practical behind the verified card, glowing at #FDE7C8

camera.setup: A: three-quarter elevated, 30 to 40 degrees above the plane
camera.focus: sharp on the verified card and badge, unlit group softly rendered
camera.framing: approximately 45 to 55 degree horizontal field of view, moderate compression, focal group sharp, background softly defocused

background.falloff: darker toward the top of the frame

composition_rules.focal_position: right of centre, roughly on a third
composition_rules.physical_plausibility: every object must be able to stand, lean or lie as shown
composition_rules.one_focal_group: exactly one warm-lit focal group with a single light source: the verified card, lit
composition_rules.navy_group_rule: the navy element is one object, or repetitions of one identical object in one contiguous composition; never mixed navy objects
composition_rules.navy_range: subdued navy paper only, #1A2340 to #3F4A68; no vivid, emitted or periwinkle blue

negative: Google or browser or search-engine marks
more than one warm light source
more than one navy element group
